title: Store Parameterless New Constructor
description: Ensure every Store in semio/rs has parameterless new() that allocates a fresh id and leaves an empty shell for the ongoing refactor.
summary: Added `export_semio_graphql_schema_file` ignored test to the `tests` module in `semio/rs/lib.rs`. The test uses `block_on(crate::gql::sdl())` to generate the SDL and writes it to the path from `SEMIO_GRAPHQL_SCHEMA_OUT`. The build now runs 1 test (was 0) and correctly updates `semio/graphql/schema.graphql` (570 lines).
